name: Harsh Lesson
blurb: Active:  Illaoi's next basic attack gains  bonus attack range and causes her to  leap to her target, dealing additional physical damage and commanding nearby Tentacles to attack the target.

effects.description: Active: Illaoi empowers her next basic attack within 6 seconds to gain 225 bonus range and cause her to leap to the target's location if they are beyond her normal basic attack range.

The attack deals additional physical damage, with a minimum threshold, and capped at 300 against non-champions, and commands all Tentacles in range to attack the target. The minimum additional damage can also be applied against turrets.
Harsh Lesson resets Illaoi's basic attack timer.
Harsh Lesson can be activated during Illaoi's other abilities.

notes:
Harsh Lesson's additional damage is applied as a separate damage instance from the attack that triggers it.
This causes Harsh Lesson to trigger  Bone Plating and one of its plates with the same attack.
For this reason, prior to V26.09 it would also reduce  Arcane Comet's cooldown twice. [18] (unexpected)
The damage of Harsh Lesson's attack portion is tagged as  basic damage and  spell damage, while the additional damage is only tagged as  spell damage, allowing it to trigger  spell effects.
The additional damage doesn't apply  life steal but it does apply  spell vamp and  Omnivamp.
Harsh Lesson cannot be cast while  pulling a Spirit.
Harsh Lesson is made of two different abilities which are decided by Illaoi's range to the target, being either  melee or within  dash range, causing interactions to act differently.
 Interrupt:
The melee attack has an  uncancellable windup.
Starting the attack before triggering  Guardian Angel's passive and hitting while she's in it will not cause the Tentacles to slam. [19]
The dash attack does not have an uncancellable windup, meaning effects that can interrupt the dash will cancel the attack.
Unlike other empowered basic attacks, an interrupt on the dash attack will still cause the buff to be consumed and the ability to be put on cooldown. [20]
That includes self effects, such as  Flash. [21] (unexpected)
 Ground or  root:
The melee attack can be used. If Illaoi attack commands and then casts Harsh Lesson while rooted, she is able to use the close range version within its dash range. (unexpected)
The dash ability can be cast but cannot be used while  grounded or  rooted because Illaoi loses the  bonus attack range.
 Spell shield:
The melee attack does not pop the spell shield. (unexpected)
The dash attack pops the spell shield, preventing Tentacle commands but not preventing the additional damage. [22]
 Block,  dodge and  blind:
Tentacles will slam if the melee attack is blocked [23], but will not if it's dodged [24] or if it misses [25]. (unexpected)
In all cases the empowered attack additional damage is prevented. (unexpected)
Tentacles will slam if the dash attack is blocked, dodged or if it misses.
The empowered attack additional damage is dealt when the attack is blocked or dodged, but is not if it misses.
The melee attack will still hit if the target becomes  untargetable [26], while the dash attack will not. [27] (unexpected)
The melee attack will not hit if the target has  died, while the dash attack will hit. [28]
In a frame perfect situation, the melee attack will also hit, however it will not make the Tentacles slam. [29] (unexpected)
The melee attack triggers Tentacle slams when hitting a  structure, while the dash attack does not. [30] (unexpected)
The melee attack triggers  Hail of Blades, while the dash attack does not. [31] (unexpected)
If the empowered attack duration ends during the melee animation, the attack won't be empowered (unexpected), but if it ends during the dash - then the buff will linger until the attack has finished. [32]
Illaoi can quickly cast other abilities after melee hitting the target, but after dash hitting there is a short delay. [33] (unexpected)
Abilities cannot be buffered during the melee windup but they can be buffered during the dash windup. (unexpected)
Attack speed will desync the animation from the dash. [34] (unexpected)
The Tentacle attacking because of Harsh Lesson is considered to be of the same cast instance, and thus will not grant additional stacks of  Conqueror,  Electrocute and Tribute.
